jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a
AI Engineer
to build and deploy production-ready AI solutions in
Python
. You’ll work on
RAG applications, LLM-based solutions, AI agents and agentic workflows
, using technologies such as LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks. You’ll also work with vector databases, embeddings, AI evaluation, observability, security and governance. If you have hands-on GenAI experience and want to build AI solutions that make it into production, let’s connect!
🚀
Project
- developing production-grade Generative AI applications in Python
- designing and implementing RAG solutions and LLM-based applications
- developing AI agents and agentic workflows
- working with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar frameworks
- implementing vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search
- integrating AI solutions with enterprise data sources and APIs
- implementing LLM evaluation using Ragas, TruLens, or custom frameworks
- setting up AI observability using LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
- implementing AI security, guardrails, and governance
- deploying and operating AI applications in cloud environments
🎯
Skills
-
4+ years
in Software Engineering or AI/ML development
- 2+ years of hands-on Generative AI experience
- strong Python skills
- practical experience with
LLMs, RAG and/or AI agents
- experience with vector databases
- hands-on experience with at least one relevant GenAI/agentic framework
- experience delivering AI solutions into production
💡
Nice to have
- Azure/Azure OpenAI
- banking
- Snowflake
- enterprise data transformation
- regulated environments
#LI-SP1

jobs.title: Kubernetes Engineer
jobs.description:
Hľadám
Kubernetes Engineera
pre správu a rozvoj kontajnerovej infraštruktúry. Budete sa venovať prevádzke Kubernetes prostredia,
CI/CD
pipeline, monitoringu a bezpečnosti. Súčasťou role je aj práca s databázami,
IaC
nástrojmi a riešenie výkonu systémov. Požadujem skúsenosti s Kubernetes,
Linuxom
a skriptovacími jazykmi.
🚀
Projekt
- inštalácia a správa Kubernetes prostredia
- zabezpečenie zálohovania a disaster recovery v Kubernetes (Kasten K10, Velero)
- škálovanie aplikácií a implementácia deployment stratégií (KEDA, blue-green deployment)
- správa container image registry (Harbor, GitLab) a tvorba/testovanie Docker/Podman images
- konfigurácia a optimalizácia CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Azure DevOps)
- nasadzovanie a prevádzka databáz (PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis)
- implementácia Infrastructure as Code (Helm, Terraform, Ansible)
- implementácia a správa monitoringu (Prometheus, Grafana)
- centralizované logovanie a alerting (Loki, ELK stack)
- analýza výkonnosti systémov a proaktívne riešenie problémov

- využitie SBOM a vulnerability scannerov na zvýšenie bezpečnosti
- správa certifikátov, šifrovania a secrets (Vault, PKI)

- skúsenosti s CSI implementáciami (Longhorn, NVMe over TCP)
- znalosť programovacích jazykov (Python, Go, Bash)
- znalosť administrácie Linux

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Hledám
Data Engineera
pro návrh a správu datových pipeline mezi on-premise
SQL Serverem
a
Google Cloud Platform.
Budete řešit
CDC,
streaming, návrh a optimalizaci struktur v
BigQuery
a orchestrace procesů v
Airflow/Cloud Composer.
Součástí role je monitoring, troubleshooting a spolupráce s businessem na převodu požadavků do technického řešení. Požaduji silnou znalost SQL Server, T-SQL, ETL nástrojů, GCP, BigQuery, Pythonu a datového modelování.
🚀
Projekt
- budování a správa datových pipeline mezi on-premise SQL Server prostředím a Google Cloud Platform
- návrh a realizace přesunu a synchronizace dat do cloudu včetně Change Data Capture (CDC) a streamingu
- návrh a optimalizace datových struktur v BigQuery (partitioning, clustering) s důrazem na výkon a nákladovou efektivitu
- automatizace a orchestrace datových procesů pomocí Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataform a dalších nástrojů
- monitoring produkčních pipeline, troubleshooting, řešení incidentů a kontrola kvality dat
- práce s dimensional modellingem a Star/Snowflake schématy
- spolupráce s analytiky a businessem a převod jejich požadavků do technického řešení
🎯
Skills
- zkušenost na pozici Data Engineer / DWH Engineer nebo v podobné data roli
- zkušenost s end-to-end datovými pipelines
- velmi dobrá znalost SQL Server a T-SQL
- zkušenost se stored procedures, CTEs a SQL performance tuningem
- zkušenost se SSIS nebo jiným ETL/integration nástrojem
- praktická zkušenost s Google Cloud Platform
- BigQuery
- Google Cloud Storage
- Python
- Pandas nebo PySpark
- dimensional modelling
- Star/Snowflake schema
- zkušenost s orchestrace datových workflow (Airflow / Cloud Composer)
- schopnost monitoringu a troubleshooting produkčních pipeline
💡

- Terraform
- Git
- CI/CD
- GitHub Actions
- Jenkins
- Pub/Sub
- streaming
- Dataflow
- Dataproc
- Cloud Composer
- Airflow
- Dataform
- Databricks
- Data Mesh
- Data Products
- hlubší zkušenost s CDC

architectures using

expertise (

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
I’m looking for an experienced
DevOps Engineer
. You’ll be working with
GitLab CI/CD and API, Kubernetes, containers, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring and automation
. The role covers everything from automated repository onboarding and central configuration to performance tuning, observability, secure credential management and operational documentation. Strong experience with
Renovate, GitLab, Kubernetes and IaC
is key, together with solid scripting skills in
Bash, Python
or
JavaScript/TypeScript
.
🚀
Project
- implementing and deploying a self-hosted Renovate environment, including containers, workers, and job orchestration
- automating repository discovery and onboarding via the GitLab API
- implementing central configuration presets and repository-specific extension mechanisms
- setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, and reporting dashboards covering coverage, throughput, and error rates

- integrating artifact registries and secure credential stores
- preparing operational documentation and runbooks
- supporting development teams during the rollout
🎯
Skills
- solid experience as a DevOps, Platform or Automation Engineer
- very good knowledge of GitLab CI/CD and the GitLab API
- practical experience with containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code, such as OpenTofu and Helm
- good scripting and programming skills, for example Bash, Python or JavaScript/TypeScript
- experience with monitoring and observability, ideally with New Relic
- knowledge of secrets management, such as Vault, and package/container registries
- experience with Renovate
- independent and structured approach to work with an automation-oriented mindset
- good spoken English

jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
Hledám seniorního
Infrastructure Architekta
pro rozvoj a provoz
IaaS
platformy postavené na
Apache CloudStack (KVM).
Budete se podílet na návrhu a správě cloudové infrastruktury, řešení produkčních incidentů a rozvoji budoucích
PaaS
služeb nad stávající IaaS vrstvou. Klíčová je zkušenost s

virtualizací, networkingem a automatizací pomocí

- proaktívny prístup k riešeniu problémov a riadeniu priorít
- silné analytické a organizačné zručnosti
